exposure: maternal age group (>= 40 years, 35-39 years, 20-34 years)
cohort: Pregnant women who delivered after 24 weeks of gestation between January 2014 and July 2020, categorized into three maternal age groups: 40 years and above, 35-39 years, and 20-34 years (control group).
finding: Maternal age significantly influences obstetric outcomes, with higher risks of GDM, infertility, and lower vaginal delivery rates observed in older women.
mod_finding: Older maternal age groups (35-39 and >=40 years) were associated with significantly lower vaginal delivery rates and higher elective caesarean section rates compared to women aged 20-34 years.
